entries.title: Company overview
entries.text: R.R Teen Set Solution is a GST-registered tin shed (teen shed), steel structure, PEB and fabrication contractor based in Najafgarh, New Delhi, serving Delhi NCR since 2016. Proprietor & CEO: Subhash Kumar, who supervises projects from site survey to handover. 500+ projects completed. 5.0 rating on IndiaMART (verified supplier). It is a contractor (fabrication + installation), not a steel manufacturer or franchise.

entries.title: Contact, hours, quote process
entries.text: Phone/WhatsApp: +91 85272 58462. Email: info@rrteensetsolution.com. Working hours: Monday-Saturday, 9 AM-7 PM. Enquiries get a response within about 2 hours. Free site visit (no charge, no obligation) in Delhi NCR. Detailed quotation is shared on WhatsApp within 24 hours of the site visit; same-day quote possible for urgent projects. Project size accepted: 100 sq.ft to 1,00,000+ sq.ft.

entries.title: GST, invoice, payment terms
entries.text: GSTIN 07DJCPK0635M1Z5. Proper GST invoice on every project (useful for B2B and government work). Quoted rates are BEFORE GST; GST is 18% for commercial/industrial sheds (some agricultural structures may qualify for a lower rate, confirmed at site visit). Payment terms: typically 50% advance and 50% on completion; large projects can be milestone-based (booking advance, payment at material delivery, balance on completion). This is a staged plan, not a bank EMI. Accepted: bank transfer, UPI, NEFT, cheque.

entries.title: Rates per sq.ft (before GST)
entries.text:
All rates are indicative, per sq.ft, before 18% GST, and vary with size, span, height, material and location. Final price only after free site visit.
- Tin shed: Rs 180-250/sq.ft (basic residential Rs 180-200).
- Industrial shed: Rs 200-300/sq.ft (5000 sq.ft roughly Rs 10-15 lakh).
- PEB structure: Rs 220-380/sq.ft (large 10,000 sq.ft factory roughly Rs 22-35 lakh; 30-40% cheaper than RCC).
- Prefab warehouse: Rs 185-280/sq.ft (5000 sq.ft roughly Rs 9-12 lakh; cold storage Rs 12-16 lakh per 5000 sq.ft).
- Agricultural shed: Rs 175-200/sq.ft. Prefab factory shed: Rs 190-240. Prefab shed: Rs 175-210. MS fabrication: Rs 180-230. Prefab building (multi-storey): Rs 250-320.
Never quote an exact total for a specific project; give the range and invite the free site visit or the cost calculator.

entries.title: Optional add-ons (per sq.ft unless stated)
entries.text: Insulation sheet +Rs 15/sq.ft. Turbo ventilator +Rs 8/sq.ft. Side windows +Rs 12/sq.ft. Sliding door +Rs 20,000 fixed. Anti-rust coating +Rs 25/sq.ft. Colour options +Rs 10/sq.ft (15+ colours).

entries.title: Materials and build quality
entries.text: IS-grade certified structural steel with anti-rust coating. Typical spec: main pole 4x4 inch (10 gauge), purlins 2.5x2.5 inch (12 gauge), one coat anti-rust black paint. Same documented material specification is used for the whole project (given in writing). With IS-grade steel and coating a shed typically lasts 20-25 years in Delhi NCR; substandard material can fail in 3-5 years. Roofing sheets: corrugated GI, colour-coated, insulated panels.

entries.title: Typical build timelines
entries.text: Tin shed: small (500-1000 sq.ft) about 7-12 days, medium (1000-5000 sq.ft) 15-21 days, large industrial 25-35 days. PEB: small (up to 5000 sq.ft) 25-35 days, medium (5000-20,000) 35-55 days, large 50-80 days (about 50% faster than RCC). Prefab warehouse: up to 3000 sq.ft 15-20 days, 3000-10,000 sq.ft 20-35 days, large 35-55 days. Written timeline commitment is given before work starts. Timelines are estimates, confirmed after site visit.

entries.title: Warranty and after-sales support
entries.text: Standard workmanship warranty on fabrication and installation, with manufacturer warranty on sheeting passed through where applicable. Support tickets (quality, delay, billing/GST, warranty) can be raised on the Support page; billing queries are usually resolved in 24-48 hours, site-visit issues in 3-7 days. Do not promise specific warranty years; refer to the team for terms.

entries.title: Permissions and documents
entries.text: Most residential and small commercial tin sheds inside your own plot need no separate permission. Large industrial sheds or rooftop terrace sheds in Delhi may fall under DDA/MCD norms; the team guides on this during planning. For industrial sheds, keep the plot layout/naksha and land documents ready; approvals are discussed at the site visit.

entries.title: Tin shed fabrication
entries.text: Residential, commercial and industrial tin sheds with IS-grade GI sheets: terrace sheds, car parking sheds, shop-front sheds. Starts from Rs 180/sq.ft. Smaller and simpler than an industrial shed.

entries.title: Industrial shed
entries.text: Factory and manufacturing sheds up to 60 m clear span (no middle columns), MS frame, earthquake-resistant design. Overhead EOT crane support from 2 to 10 ton (girders and runway beams can be included). Fire exits, ventilation and fire-retardant coating can be planned at design stage. For spans beyond 60 m, PEB is recommended.

entries.title: PEB structure
entries.text: Pre-engineered buildings up to 90 m span. Designed to IS 800 and IS 1893 (seismic). Faster and cheaper than RCC; fully customisable (span, height, roof slope, colour, ventilation, mezzanine). PEB is a construction method; a prefab warehouse is a use-case usually built with PEB. Best for large factories; tin shed suits residential and small commercial.

entries.title: Prefab warehouse
entries.text: Weather-proof warehouses for logistics, storage and cold storage. Forklift-compatible (RCC flooring recommended, clear height 7-12 m). Loading bays, dock levelers and wide gates can be planned at design stage.

entries.title: Roofing, roof repair, waterproofing
entries.text: Residential terrace roofing, commercial and industrial roofing, plus repair of leaking, rusted or storm-damaged roofs and monsoon waterproofing. Roofing in Delhi NCR ranges from about Rs 170/sq.ft (basic residential) to Rs 350/sq.ft (large-span industrial PEB roofing).

entries.title: Other services
entries.text: Agricultural sheds (poultry, dairy, crop storage), prefab factory sheds, prefab buildings, prefab sheds, MS fabrication (trusses, columns, purlins), end-to-end shed fabrication and installation.

entries.title: Free cost calculator
entries.text: Free online shed cost calculator at shed-cost-calculator.html: choose shed type, enter dimensions and add-ons for an instant planning estimate (roughly 80-90% accurate). Final cost is confirmed only after site visit.

entries.title: Service area overview
entries.text: Free site visit in Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad and Ghaziabad; projects also done in the wider NCR and nearby Haryana/UP/Rajasthan towns. City pages exist for: Bahadurgarh, Bawana, Bhiwadi, Dwarka, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Gurugram, Karnal, Kundli, Manesar, Meerut, Narela, Noida, Palwal, Panipat, Rewari, Rohtak, Sonipat.
